upstream_notice_status: The published package and inspected upstream repository contain no standalone license or copyright notice file. The MIT declaration is preserved from upstream Cargo.toml.
changes: Declare the address-only _NSConcreteStackBlock symbol as inhabited c_void and obtain its raw address before casting to the existing private Class pointer. Public block APIs and pointer layout remain unchanged.

The upstream manifest references an Objective-C unit-test fixture omitted from the published crate. Disable that unavailable library test target and provide an independent Rust block call/copy/drop integration regression without extra dependencies.

Spell the existing C ABI explicitly on all extern declarations and function-pointer types, and record the existing 2015 edition. This removes missing_abi deprecation diagnostics without changing calling conventions.
removal_condition: Remove this patch when the selected graphics dependency chain supports a maintained compatible block implementation. Revalidate native Metal presentation and block copy/drop behavior.
